title: EssenceSMP
description: A dynamic Minecraft core plugin featuring rare bloodline paths, custom resource harvesting, and ultimate tier-unlockable active abilities.
body:
## ✨ EssenceSMP Core Plugin
Welcome to the official core engine for the EssenceSMP. This plugin features custom legendary paths, dynamic player scaling, and special custom abilities!

### 🔮 Available Bloodlines & Roll Rarities:
* **Phantom** — *Common (50% Chance)*: Fade into the shadows and inflict blinding decay.
* **Ocean Avenger** — *Uncommon (25% Chance)*: Master aquatic agility and crush foes with a tidal wave.
* **Earth Shaker** — *Rare (15% Chance)*: Shatter the ground and launch enemies into orbit.
* **Wind Dancer** — *Epic (8% Chance)*: Control the breeze and fling targets away at hurricane speeds.
* **Pyromancer** — *Legendary (2% Chance)*: Passively reap the souls of your victims from a 60-block vision line and summon a spectral army!

---

### 🎮 Player Commands
* `/essence check` - Check your currently assigned bloodline class and active essence tier.
* `/cast <1|2|3>` - Activate your unlocked bloodline skills.

### 🛡️ Admin Setup Commands
* `/setabilitypower <player> <1-5/Name>` - Manually shift or assign a player's bloodline path.
* `/setpower <player> <1-5>` - Manage and upgrade a player's core Essence Unlock Tier.

---
*Built for Spigot/Paper 1.21+*
